title: Skaggs 1994 single-lamella AF, tension along the fibres: typical stress-strain curve (best-fit cubic, Fig 6)

quantity.name: stress-strain curve
quantity.definition: engineering stress (force / undeformed gauge cross-section after equilibration in 0.15 M NaCl) vs gauge-mark engineering strain, single lamella loaded along its fibres; EVALUATED by extractor from the best-fit cubic of the typical specimen given in the Fig 6 caption, sigma = 5.7 e + 6532 e^3 (MPa), from 0 to the failure strain e_f = 0.056 (sigma_f = 1.5 MPa)

source.authors: Skaggs DL, Weidenbaum M, Iatridis JC, Ratcliffe A, Mow VC
source.sample: 59 dumbbell single-lamella specimens (gauge 2.90 x 1.51 x 0.63 mm) from 13 L2-L3 discs, grade I-II, autopsy within 24 h (AO, AI, PO, PI); curve = one typical specimen (region not stated)

protocol.summary: Single lamellae dissected microsurgically (verified by polarised light), dumbbell die aligned with the fibres (30 or 150 deg to the transverse plane); ends on polishing paper in spring-loaded jaws; 0.15 M NaCl bath, room temperature (hydration ~83%); preconditioning 10 cycles to 0.05 N at 0.4 Hz; tare ~0.1 N with 15 min relaxation; stretched to failure at 0.00009 /s (~20 min); strain from gauge marks by video dimension analyser (Methods, p.1312-1313).
how_to_simulate: Model a single AF lamella strip (gauge ~2.9 x 1.5 x 0.63 mm) with the fibres along the load axis
Start from the tare-load state (~0.1 N) and stretch quasi-statically (0.00009 /s) along the fibres
Report nominal stress (force / undeformed cross-section) vs gauge strain from 0 to 5.6%
protocol.notes: Regional tangent moduli at 0.75 e_f (Fig 7: AO 136+-50, PO 82+-43, AI 76+-50, PI 59+-41 MPa, n=36 specimens from 9 spines) and failure stress/strain by region (Table 1) are reported but not extracted here: the annulus card holds stress-strain curves only. Fit check: tangent at 0.75 e_f = 5.7 + 3*6532*0.042^2 = 40.3 MPa, matching E = 40 MPa in Fig 6; fit at e_f = 1.47 MPa vs sigma_f = 1.5 MPa.

extraction.from: Fig 6 caption (cubic coefficients), PDF p.5 (journal p.1313)
extraction.uncertainty: fit curve, exact from coefficients; fit deviates from the plotted experimental points by up to ~0.1 MPa (visual)
extraction.check_notes: Coefficients re-read from the 200 dpi page image (sigma = 5.7e + 6532e^3); evaluated curve compared against the Fig 6 triangles (e.g. ~0.65 MPa at e=0.04, ~1.5 MPa at e=0.056).

pass_rule.rule: model curve within the band of single-lamella curves over the tested range
